title: Projects with a pulse.
intro: A growing archive of personal and academic work. Each project is a chance to make a system clearer than I found it.

items.name: AeroDent Online
items.description: A multi-tenant dental clinic management system with role-based access, secure X-ray storage, inventory, and an Android companion app, alongside a local-first offline mode.
items.idea: Give every clinic its own secure workspace while keeping the option to work fully offline.
items.problem: Clinics needed shared records for doctors and secretaries without mixing data between clinics or exposing sensitive patient files.
items.build: A Flask REST API on PostgreSQL with session authentication, a role matrix for head doctors, doctors and secretaries, strict clinic-level data isolation, protected X-ray streaming, inventory with batches and expiry, invoices, and a vanilla JS frontend in English and Arabic. An offline PWA mode and an Android WebView app share the same interface.

items.name: AeroDent
items.description: An offline-first dental clinic application for patients, odontograms, treatments, appointments, and prescriptions, with no backend or internet needed.
items.idea: Keep everyday clinic work available on the device, even without a connection.
items.problem: Important clinical information was spread across different workflows, and many clinics cannot rely on a server or a stable connection.
items.build: A vanilla JavaScript PWA storing data in IndexedDB, with a dental odontogram for permanent and primary teeth, treatment plans, printable prescriptions, X-ray records, JSON and Excel backup, PIN protection with PBKDF2 and auto-lock, English and Arabic with RTL, and a Windows desktop build through Tauri.

items.name: EduPath
items.description: A Flask study platform where teachers manage subjects, lessons and MCQ tests, and students practice, compete in duels, and earn certificates.
items.idea: Make practice feel like progress instead of pressure.
items.problem: Learning content needed a practical way to move between lessons, assessment, and teacher management in one place.
items.build: A Flask and SQLite app with teacher and student roles, subject, section and lesson management, MCQ tests with scores, friendly duels with invite links and synchronized timers, a gems reward system, leaderboards, a review of frequently missed questions, assignments, and certificate issuance with verification.

items.name: My Stickies
items.description: A custom online store for a small sticker business, with a React storefront, a Django API, and its own admin dashboard.
items.idea: A simple store that a small business can run without a heavy platform.
items.problem: A sticker, poster and brooch shop needed guest checkout, flexible categories and variations, and an easy way to manage products.
items.build: A Django REST Framework backend on SQLite with a React (Vite) storefront and custom admin dashboard. It supports guest checkout with a browser-stored cart, unlimited nested categories, product variations with their own prices, Google Drive images, and deployment on Ubuntu with Gunicorn and Nginx.

items.name: EPay Store
items.description: A full-stack online store with a product catalog, cart and checkout, and a secure admin dashboard for products, categories and orders.
items.idea: A complete shop experience, from browsing to order confirmation.
items.problem: A small business needed customers to search, filter and order easily, and the owner to manage everything in one place.
items.build: A Node.js and MongoDB backend with JWT-protected admin routes and email notifications through Nodemailer, plus a responsive React frontend with search, category filters, a cart, checkout, and order status management.

items.name: C++ Debugger
items.description: A header-only debugging helper for competitive programming in C++ that prints variables and containers in a readable form.
items.idea: Make debugging during contests quick and readable.
items.problem: Printing variables and containers by hand is slow, and debug output must not slow down or break submissions on online judges.
items.build: A single header file with a debug macro that prints names and values for common types and iterable containers such as vector, set, map and pair. It is skipped automatically on online judges via the ONLINE_JUDGE flag. Based on the well-known debug template by Tourist.

items.name: C++ Login System
items.description: A console login and register system in C++ that stores usernames and passwords in local text files.
items.idea: Understand how a basic account flow works from scratch.
items.problem: Learning file handling and program structure needs a small but complete example, with no libraries to hide the logic.
items.build: A C++ program split into a login module and a main screen, with registration, sign-in checks against saved credentials, and local .txt file storage.

items.name: 2D Pursuit Curve
items.description: A MATLAB simulation of a single-pursuer pursuit curve, solved numerically with the fourth-order Runge-Kutta method.
items.idea: See a differential equation as a chase unfolding over time.
items.problem: The path of a pursuer who always heads toward a moving target has no simple closed form in general, so it has to be solved numerically.
items.build: A pure MATLAB implementation of the single-pursuer problem that integrates the differential equation with RK4 and plots the resulting trajectories.
